paper_title: Few-shot Hate Speech Detection Based on the MindSpore Framework
caption: Ablation study on the HateXplain dataset. The line chart illustrates variations in precision, recall, and F1-score across different model variants of MS-FSLHate.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance metrics of different model variants used in an ablation study on the HateXplain Dataset. The x-axis represents the "Model Variants", labeled as nominal categories: "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis represents "Metric (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 58 to 66, marked at intervals of 2%. The purple line, representing "Precision," uses circles as markers and a solid line style. It starts at 65.45% with the "Full model (Ours)" and fluctuates across the variants, at 61.06% with "w/o Prompt", 62.22% for "w/o Augmentation", 64.06% for "w/o Attention", and ending at 65.44% with "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The blue line signifies "Recall" featuring circles and a solid line. It begins at 65.78% for "Ours", drops to 59.64% with "w/o Prompt," and rises at 62.63% for "w/o Augmentation," and dips again at 59.17% for "w/o Attention" followed by 56.82% at "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The brown line illustrates the "F1-score" using circles and a solid line, starting at 65.16%, decreasing to 60.16% for "w/o Prompt", reaching 62.63% at "w/o Augmentation", 59.67% for "w/o Attention" and concluding at 57.74% with "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". There is a legend on the bottom left of the plot to infer the line color from their labels.
